Salesforce

Make sales ownership, qualification, and pipeline progress visible.

SOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Salesforce Sales Cloud supports CRM records, sales processes, and documented APIs. MoreSpace can model the lead-to-opportunity journey, connect authorized source systems, and create operational views that show ownership, qualification, next actions, and the commercial meaning of each pipeline stage.

Useful outputs

  • Configured sales record structures and stage progression rules
  • Reviewed integration mappings and owner-ready follow-up views
  • Pipeline reporting with documented calculations and access controls

Where we can apply it

  • Reviewed lead source → identity match → CRM record → assigned qualification task.
  • Qualified account → opportunity stage → next sales action → pipeline review.
  • CRM stage history → agreed measures → commercial scorecard → weekly sales decisions.
01

Use case 1

Structure lead, account, contact, and opportunity records around the sales process.

02

Use case 2

Connect reviewed lead sources and operational events with CRM ownership.

03

Use case 3

Build pipeline and qualification scorecards with documented field and stage definitions.

Inputs we need

  • Sales stages, qualification definitions, and account relationship rules
  • Authorized CRM records and proposed integration field mappings
  • User roles, assignment owners, and reporting requirements

Delivery sequence

  • Agree record relationships and the meaning of each sales stage.
  • Configure fields and scoped integrations, then test representative record updates.
  • Reconcile reports and verify access from each intended user's perspective.

Expert review points

  • Review conflicting field changes and duplicates before enabling synchronization.
  • Approve stage definitions, routing responsibility, and role-specific record access.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
